## 3. Variation in scale

Gains 10^U(−a, a) applied (a) per **row** (one gain per output row: every block lies inside one row, so its scale absorbs the gain), (b) per **column** (input channel: gains change inside every block). 'weak 25%' = error of the Y rows with the 25% smallest gains (row mode), or of the part of Y coming from the 25% of input columns with the smallest gains (column mode). Last column: BFP6 blocks whose 4-bit exponent clamps (out of 700).
